Als frisch verheiratetes Paar hatten wir einen wundervollen Aufenthalt im Hotel Boulevard, Autograph Collection. Von der ersten Minute an wurden wir mit außergewöhnlicher Gastfreundschaft empfangen. Das Personal war unglaublich freundlich und hilfsbereit und hat alles dafür getan, dass unser Aufenthalt perfekt wurde.

Unser Zimmer war traumhaft – geräumig, stilvoll eingerichtet und makellos sauber. Es war der ideale Ort, um zu entspannen und die Zeit zu zweit zu genießen. Die Lage des Hotels ist unschlagbar: mitten in Dubai und nur einen kurzen Spaziergang vom ikonischen Burj Khalifa entfernt – ideal, um die Stadt zu erkunden.

Das Frühstück war jeden Morgen ein Highlight. Das Buffet bot eine große Auswahl, und die Gerichte von der Karte waren einfach köstlich – mit Abstand einige der besten Speisen, die wir je probiert haben!

Der Poolbereich war stets sauber, und der Rettungsschwimmer war äußerst freundlich und aufmerksam. Er hat stets darauf geachtet, dass wir gut hydriert und komfortabel waren. Die Sonnenliegen waren bequem und perfekt zum Entspannen, allerdings gab es leider nur etwa 3–4 Stunden direkte Sonneneinstrahlung, was vermutlich an der Lage des Hotels und der Jahreszeit lag.

Insgesamt hatten wir einen traumhaften Aufenthalt und können dieses Hotel jedem empfehlen, der Luxus, Komfort und erstklassigen Service sucht. Es war der perfekte Start in unser Eheleben!
textTranslated:
As a newly married couple, we had a wonderful stay at Hotel Boulevard, Autograph Collection. From the first minute we were welcomed with exceptional hospitality. The staff were incredibly friendly and helpful and did everything they could to make our stay perfect.

Our room was gorgeous – spacious, stylishly decorated and spotlessly clean. It was the ideal place to relax and enjoy time together. The hotel's location is unbeatable: right in the middle of Dubai and just a short walk from the iconic Burj Khalifa - ideal for exploring the city.

Breakfast was a highlight every morning. The buffet had a wide selection and the menu items were simply delicious - by far some of the best food we've ever tasted!

The pool area was always clean and the lifeguard was extremely friendly and attentive. He always made sure we were well hydrated and comfortable. The sun loungers were comfortable and perfect for relaxing, although unfortunately there was only about 3-4 hours of direct sunlight, which was probably due to the location of the hotel and the time of year.

Overall, we had a wonderful stay and can recommend this hotel to anyone looking for luxury, comfort and first-class service. It was the perfect start to our married life!

feedback_text:
The hotel is in an excellent location, making it easy to get around. We were warmly welcomed upon arrival and even received a complimentary upgrade to a room with a terrace, which was a pleasant surprise. The hotel itself has a very nice atmosphere and is a pleasure to stay in, though the rooms do show some signs of needing cosmetic updates. The terrace was large but not very practical, as it only had a single couch that wasn’t in great condition. It would have been much better if there was a table so we could have enjoyed meals outside.

The breakfasts were fantastic—delicious and plentiful. There was a wide variety, and we tried different dishes every day, with each one being excellent.

At the pool, the staff was incredibly friendly and attentive. They always found us a spot, laid out towels, and even served complimentary lemon water with ice. Although the pool was small, it was perfect for cooling off and swimming a little.

One downside was that we requested adapters for our chargers several times, but despite being told they would be brought to us, we never received them.

Overall, we left with a very positive impression of the hotel and enjoyed our stay, despite a few minor issues.

One of the highlights of my stay was the dining experience at the hotel's restaurant. The food was exquisite, with a diverse menu that catered to all tastes. Whether it was breakfast by the pool or a romantic dinner under the stars, the culinary offerings never failed to impress.

The hotel's amenities were also top-notch. I particularly enjoyed the swimming pool and spa facilities, which provided the perfect opportunity to unwind and relax after a day of sightseeing.

Overall, my stay at the Hotel Autograph Boulevard Collection was nothing short of exceptional. textTranslated:
The hotel is located in a very excellent location close to Dubai Mall, in an area suitable for walking and riding a bike or even a scooter. Of course, in the summer the situation differs due to the heat of the sun, so the location is 10/10.

The prices are very reasonable, but sometimes they are high during the seasons. The hotel is classified as 4 stars, but I think it is superior to five or six-star hotels in terms of cleanliness, service, sustainability, room design, and excellent location.
So 10/10.

This is not the first time, but I have lived there more than once. I have an Emaar and Allcor membership and I benefit from it for points, accounts, and so on.

The hotel includes a small swimming pool and a small gym.
There is no spa
The breakfast is very excellent, few options but very high quality. 10/10

The rooms are modernly designed. 10/10
The room provides (shampoo + conditioner + body soap, and hygiene tools) and is of excellent quality.
A bathtub is available for those interested.

Taxis are available at the hotel at market prices, and the workers serve you with all the details.

The entire area includes luxurious restaurants that I recommend trying.

I will visit and stay in the same hotel again.

feedback_text: Mein Mann und ich sind für eine Woche in diesem Hotel übernachtet. Das Hotel ist relativ zentral, wir brauchen zur Dubai Mall ca. 15 Minuten zu Fuß. Zum Strand ist es weiter weg, da wir aber jeden Tag unterwegs waren um die Stadt zu erkunden, war das kein Problem für uns. Das Hotel hat einen kleinen Pool mit gemütlichen Pavillons, was für ein-zwei Tage Sonnen kein Problem war. Wir haben unseren Aufenthalt mit Frühstück gebucht. Das Angebot war in Ordnung, leider musste man vielen über die Internetseite bestellen, es gab also keine stinknormalen Eier die man sich auf die Schnelle holen konnte, man hat etwas bestellt und das hat leider eine halbe Ewigkeit gedauert bis es da war. Bis dahin hatten wir meist gar keinen Hunger mehr. Die Zimmer waren in Ordnung, fürs übernachten hat es gereicht, jedoch ist die Sauberkeit leider nicht so wichtig für das Hotel. Handtücher wurde manchmal auch einfach nicht verteilt. Am Abreisetag haben wir uns den ganzen Tag über am Pool aufgehalten, leider wurde uns aber nicht gesagt, dass die Dusche im offenen ist und alle einen sehen können, daher konnten wir uns nicht richtig abduschen, was für mich leider ein No-go ist. Im Zimmer sind auch keine Föhns vorhanden aber auf den Toiletten am Pool war eins vorhanden. Fazit; das Hotel ist okay.
textTranslated: My husband and I stayed at this hotel for a week. The hotel is relatively central, it took us about 15 minutes to walk to the Dubai Mall. It's further away from the beach, but since we were out exploring the city every day, that wasn't a problem for us. The hotel has a small pool with cozy pavilions, which wasn't a problem for a day or two of sunbathing. We booked our stay with breakfast. The offer was okay, unfortunately you had to order a lot of them via the website, so there were no perfectly normal eggs that you could get in a hurry, you ordered something and unfortunately it took forever until it arrived. By then we were usually no longer hungry. The rooms were okay, enough to stay overnight, but unfortunately cleanliness is not that important for the hotel. Towels were sometimes simply not distributed. On the day of departure we stayed at the pool all day, but unfortunately we weren't told that the shower was open and everyone could see us, so we couldn't shower properly, which is unfortunately a no-go for me. There are no hairdryers in the room, but there was one in the toilets by the pool. Conclusion; the hotel is okay.

feedback_text:
I recently stayed at this hotel in Dubai, and I must say that it didn't meet my expectations for a 4-star property. While there were some positives, such as the location and overall appearance, several issues left me disappointed.

Firstly, the room had damaged curtains with two noticeable burns, which was a clear sign of neglect in terms of maintenance. The low water pressure in the bathroom was another inconvenience, making it challenging to perform basic tasks like washing my hands without touching the washbasin.

Moreover, the bathroom layout was far from comfortable, with an impractical distance between the toilet and the handwashing area. This lack of ergonomic design made the overall experience less enjoyable.

To make matters worse, the absence of a spa facility was a letdown, especially for a hotel claiming to be 4-star. The most frustrating aspect was the reception's unresponsiveness to phone calls, leaving guests without a reliable point of contact for assistance.

In summary, while this hotel has some potential, it falls short of the expectations associated with a 4-star rating. I hope the management takes note of these issues and invests in improvements to provide a better experience for future guests.

Die Lage ist sehr gut und macht seinem Namen alle Ehre. Zu Fuß kann man die ganzen Sehenswürdigkeit in Downtown erreichen. Auch die Fahrt zum bzw. vom Flughafen ist sehr kurz.
Die Zimmer sind groß und sauber und mit allen Standards ausgestattet.
Der Pool lädt zum verweilen ein und auch die Musik ist hier im Hintergrund sehr angeben und nicht störend.
Besonders hervorheben möchten wir das Frühstück. Es lässt wirklich nahezu keine Wünsche offen. Es ist eine Kombination aus Buffet und Speisen à la carte. Das Buffet ist bereits reichhaltig aber besonders die Karte ist großartig. Hier kann man so oft man möchte bestellen und alle Speisen sind in hervorragender Qualität.
Wir kommen auch gerne ein drittes Mal wieder!
textTranslated:
This is the second time we have been to Vida Downtown and we can fully recommend it.
The location is very good and lives up to its name. You can reach all the attractions in downtown on foot. The journey to and from the airport is also very short.
The rooms are large and clean and equipped to all standards.
The pool invites you to linger and the music in the background is very impressive and not disturbing.
We would particularly like to highlight the breakfast. It really leaves almost nothing to be desired. It is a combination of buffet and à la carte dishes. The buffet is already extensive but the menu in particular is great. Here you can order as often as you like and all the food is of excellent quality.
We would love to come back a third time!

We had a disappointing experience and wouldn’t recommend this hotel.

There was a ridiculous towel situation. When we arrived, there was one bathrobe missing. After the first room service, almost all towels were taken away and not replaced. Which would be fine by itself, mistakes happen. We told the reception in the morning, then we told them again in the afternoon and again in the evening. Even after the room service on the next morning, the towels were still not refilled. Only after the fourth (!) complaint and a threat to talk to the manager did we receive our much anticipated towels.

The hotel tries to have a luxurious appearance, but shows very basic construction flaws and lacks all attention to detail. The switch right next to the entrance is not a general light switch, it turns on the toilet light. And next to the bed you have two switches, one for the reading light and the other - you guessed it - for the toilet light. In order to turn the other lights off, you have to walk across the room.

Regulating the shower temperature was impossible as it switched from cold to boiling hot for no apparent reason. The silicon of the shower door was falling apart. The toilet flush only works properly when you lift the lid and push the plastic thing inside it yourself. The air conditioning in the gym was either underpowered or not working properly.

We also didn’t like the heavily perfumed lobby and the fact that a persistent salesperson tries to sell you real estate while you’re waiting for the elevator.

There was construction going on in the ground floor. We weren’t informed beforehand although there was considerable noise in some areas.

The location is nice, the pool was well maintained, the bed was good and breakfast was fine. Still not at all what you expect from a four star hotel and for the price you pay.

Within 10 minutes you are at the Burj Khalifa or Dubai Mall, you have a lot of restaurants in the near of the Hotel where you also can find a menu for less money. They threw away half of the package, half of it was left))) they demanded money for the missing contents (fortunately there was a photo of the price) and they returned it to us!!! But the rest was spoiled. I have no desire to return to this hotel.

This is a great hotel, perfectly located in the smartest district of Dubai (Downtown), and there’s only a few flaws which mean it’s a not 5 star place.

Firstly the pool, amazingly designed with great beds around it right on the road yet relatively quiet/peaceful. Unfortunately, it gets no sun whatsoever - not sure if this was a design flaw or just unlucky/the only option they had, but if you come to Dubai you’ll want sun and there’s none here.

The breakfast was only ok - perhaps a previous buffet was a victim of COVID but they have a nice menu and it’s all included, they’ll also make you almost anything but it’s just not that great a quality food which is a shame. Undercooked eggs, undertoasted bred etc - the coffee is also poor. Which is all a shame as the service is good and done with a smile and professionally.

We also ordered some food by the pool (gnocchi) and it was pretty bland, soft and fairly dreadful, again not fitting with the great setting.

The rooms are very nicely designed - I don’t think ours was much better than their base one but nice all the same. However the toilet door doesn’t shut and even if it did you might as well be in the room, a tiny cubicle with a none sound proof door which doesn’t close - it’s not particularly private. The bathroom and shower are oddly laid out but I guess they’ve done what they can with the space.

Overall this is a great hotel because of location and overall decor, but the finer points are just off. That said for our stay it was around £130 a night so you can hardly complain, that’s great for Dubai.

Один из лучших отелей Дубай  ,в котором мы останавливались . А мы были за период карантина в около 10 отелях и есть с чем сравнивать .
Хотелось бы отметить вкуснейшие завтраки на уровне  сравнимы   La Serre
Безумно вкусные  яйца Бенедикт и правильная приготовленная шакшука (не везде в Дубай ее делаю вкусно и правильно )
Но тут все превосходно , очень  советую также попробовать бельгийские вафли с клинковым сиропом и ягодами , но самое главное украшение наших завтраков была улыбка и доброжелательность персонала  Raj ,который встречал нас по  утром всегда с улыбкой и дарил хорошее настроение на  весь день .
Отель не большой , но очень уютный ,  с тем самым уютом и теплом , в которых не хватает в сетевых больших отелях

Бассейн не большой , но очень удобный состоит из нескольких шатров с удобными кроватями ,  очень удобно что можно закрыть крышу шатра от солнца и просто наслаждаться тёплым  Дубайским воздухом под хорошую музыку  и холодный американо . Вечером там же можно покурить кальян и выпить бокал вина .

Номерной фонд новый , в номере все есть необходимое для комфортного перебивание ,
Хотелось отметить очень удобный матрас на котором действительно высыпаешься , так есть чайник и кофемашина , единственный минус не предусмотрено розетка в ванной комнате для сушки волос

Уборка проводиться каждый день ,чистая хрустящая постель и Замена полотенец  , мы очень много пьём и нам всегда оставляют около 6 бутылок воды в день огромное спасибо за это, иногда персонал забывает пополнять туалетные принадлежности шампуни или поставит только гель для душа забыв про шампунь ,но при  любой просьбе принесут в полной объёме

Расположение отели без всяких комментариев , downtown  вокруг много разборных кафешек , в 5 минутах ходьбы от Dubai Mall , burj Khalifa , Dubai opera , Dubai Fountain и все что нужно вам если вы турист

Этот отель заявлен как 4 звёзды , но в реальности тут все 5 звёзд .
Моя оценка 9.5 из 10. !

սա լավագույն հյուրանոցն է, պարզապես փորձեք, և չեք փոշմանի:
textTranslated:
One of the best hotels we have stayed in in Dubai. During the quarantine period, we stayed in about 10 hotels and have something to compare with.
I would like to note the delicious breakfasts at a level comparable to La Serre
Insanely delicious eggs Benedict and properly prepared shakshuka (not everywhere in Dubai I make it tasty and correctly)
But everything here is excellent, I highly recommend also trying the Belgian waffles with clinker syrup and berries, but the most important decoration of our breakfasts was the smile and friendliness of the Raj staff, who always greeted us in the morning with a smile and gave us a good mood for the whole day.
The hotel is not big, but very cozy, with that coziness and warmth that is missing in large chain hotels

The pool is not large, but very comfortable, it consists of several tents with comfortable beds, it is very convenient that you can close the roof of the tent from the sun and just enjoy the warm Dubai air with good music and a cold Americano. In the evening you can smoke a hookah and drink a glass of wine there.

The number of rooms is new, the room has everything necessary for a comfortable stay,
I would like to note the very comfortable mattress on which you really get a good night's sleep, there is a kettle and a coffee machine, the only negative is that there is no outlet in the bathroom for drying hair

Cleaning is done every day, clean crisp bed and replacement of towels, we drink a lot and they always leave us about 6 bottles of water a day, thank you very much for this, sometimes the staff forgets to replenish the toiletries, shampoos or only put shower gel, forgetting about the shampoo, but when any request will be provided in full

The location of the hotels is without any comment, there are many cafes around downtown, a 5-minute walk from the Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa, Dubai Opera, Dubai Fountain and everything you need if you are a tourist

This hotel is advertised as 4 stars, but in reality it is all 5 stars.
My rating is 9.5 out of 10!

feedback_text: Very sleek hotel with all brand new design, chic boutique hotel

This hotel is spectacular. From start to finish I was blown away by the quality of service and the amenities. I landed a little early and guest services immediately put me into a room (which after ten hours of travel time meant a whole lot!!). The staff are incredibly attentive and helpful, and most of them knew me by name and asked me about my day by the end of my trip. The location is PRIME - you are within walking distance of the Burj Khalifa and the mall, and surrounded by Michelin star restaurants. I recommend 3in1 and Downtown Too, which has a ladies night on Wednesdays. I was also given an Emirates black card that gave me a 25% discount for the attractions at the mall and the restaurants in the hotel. The rooms have USB ports, the TVs have room service options, and everything is clean and new. The pool is small but there is no minimum for the cabanas and the staff are very attentive. I loved staying here!

My experience at Vida Downtown was unfortunately very disapointing. We made a booking for a cabana for 4 people which got confirmed over the phone. On the day, the staff didn't seem to know what I was talking about. I had to speak to 3 different people before the last person decided to finally speak to the manager to check the booking. The service was awful, we asked numerous times to get at least a bottle of water, they took 20min to get back with it and got the order wrong by bringing more than what we asked for. The same thing happened again when we ordered food,  we asked at least 5 times to have our order taken within 30min, the staff would just tell us that they would be coming back and we would see them serving and taking orders for other guests. The only silver lining was the food which was really good and reasonably priced. I am not happy to write a bad review as I really thought the service would be of high standard. That being said, there was one member of staff which was on point and made sure after all this that we get what we need and when we needed. Also the hotel itself is beautiful and our stay at the pool was pleasant despite the service. Above and Beyond - Vida Downtown Dubai is as socially conscious as it is elegant. I can not say enough good things about this hotel, it's staff and how it is run. If you are a westerner, particularly an American... forget everything you think you know about traveling in the Middle East. My wife and I stayed here during an extended layover. We were met at the airport by a friendly and kind driver, checked in by an equally wonderful host (they have 24 hour check in: you check in whenever you arrive, and you have your room for 24 hours. Ideal for lay overs.) and were treated to a location central to the city. The breakfast (included in the price) was the most opulent morning meal I've ever had. My wife was treated with respect, our room was luxurious and the price was extremely reasonable. Last and not least, Vida maintains the best of Arab culture and architecture, while exuding 21st century elegance. Vida is a statement and an example, it's more than just a hotel. I'll never stay anywhere else when in Dubai.

Sincerely,
Chad & Victoria

現地在住の方のおススメとの事で、1人旅で3泊しました。Dubai Mallまで徒歩で行けます（地図上では斜向かいですが、歩くと15分くらいかかります）。お部屋／バスルームの清潔さは完璧。Wi-Fiも問題なく、コーヒー／お茶（TWGの紅茶やハーブティーでした！）もたっぷり用意されていました。朝食はビュッフェに加えてメインを10種類くらいの中から選ぶという方式。毎朝どれにするか楽しみでした。スタッフも皆さんフレンドリー且つ親切で、快適な滞在でした。次回もまた利用すると思います。
textTranslated: I stayed here for 3 nights as a solo traveller, as it was recommended by a local resident. Dubai Mall is within walking distance (although it is diagonally opposite on the map, it takes about 15 minutes to walk there). The room and bathroom were perfectly clean. Wi-Fi was fine, and there was plenty of coffee and tea (TWG black tea and herbal tea!). Breakfast was a buffet plus a choice of about 10 main dishes. I was looking forward to choosing which one to have every morning. The staff were all friendly and helpful, and it was a comfortable stay. I think I'll use it again next time.

feedback_text: Vida Downtown påminner med sin ljusa och minimalistiska inredning mer om ett hotell du skulle hitta i Skandinavien snarare än i Dubai. Den låga byggnaden i putsad sten är inte heller representativ för arkitekturen i den del av Dubai som kallas The Old Town. Läget intill Mohammed Bin Rashid Boulevard gör att du har gång avstånd till en rad restauranger, Burj Khalifa och The Dubai Mall. Men faktum är att hotellet är så pass trevligt att du klarar dig bra på att hänga några dagar vid poolen, äta på någon av de trevliga restaurangerna i samma lokal (hotellets egna har en riktigt härlig frukost med hälsosamma alternativ) eller bara hänga på de härliga rummen.
textTranslated: With its bright and minimalist interior, Vida Downtown is more reminiscent of a hotel you would find in Scandinavia rather than Dubai. The low building in polished stone is also not representative of the architecture of the part of Dubai called The Old Town. The location next to Mohammed Bin Rashid Boulevard means that you are within walking distance of a number of restaurants, the Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Mall. But the fact is that the hotel is so nice that you can do well hanging out for a few days by the pool, eating at one of the nice restaurants in the same building (the hotel's own has a really delicious breakfast with healthy options) or just hanging out in the lovely rooms.

feedback_text: Vida hotell är verkligen ett superfint hotell med ett fantastiskt läge. Hela hotellet är väldigt snyggt och poolområdet jättetrevligt. Nu marknadsför de sig dock som ett hightech hotell med alla möjliga tekniska möjligheter, men en sån enkel grej som att koppla en iPad till TV fungerade inte (den ingången hade de inte brytt sig om att ta i bruk). Vi bodde dessutom där med barn och det kan man väl säga inte riktigt är det som hotellet vill. Inga barnpriser på frukosten till exempel gjorde att vi skulle blivit tvungna att betala nästan 1 000 kronor för oss fyra (och då äter ju två av oss nästan ingenting). Vi gick till fiket på andra sidan gatan istället och käkade för 40 kr/st. Men reser du själv eller som par och vill bo inne i stan är det kanon. Jag skulle dock lagt samma peng på ett av strandhotellen istället. Att göra stan gör man ändå enkelt med taxi (det enda som är billigt i Dubai).
textTranslated: Vida Hotel is truly a super nice hotel with a fantastic location. The entire hotel is very nice and the pool area is really nice. Now they market themselves as a high-tech hotel with all sorts of technical possibilities, but something as simple as connecting an iPad to the TV didn't work (they hadn't bothered to put that input into use). We were also staying there with children and you could say that's not really what the hotel wants. No children's prices for breakfast, for example, meant that we would have had to pay almost 1,000 kronor for the four of us (and then two of us eat almost nothing). We went to the cafe across the street instead and had a meal for 40 kronor/each. But if you're traveling alone or as a couple and want to stay in the city, it's great. However, I would have spent the same money on one of the beach hotels instead. Getting around the city is still easy by taxi (the only thing that's cheap in Dubai).

feedback_text: Hyggeligt hotel tæt på Dubai Mall og med udsigt til Burj Khalifa. Godt udgangspunkt for shopping. ||Værelserne er store rummelige og i pæn stand. Fra suiten er udsigten fra balkonen imod Burj Khalifa helt fantastisk. ||Personalet var behjælpelige og servicemindede trods lidt problemer med værelser på forskellige etager - dette blev dog løst.||Morgenbuffeten bød på stort indbydende udvalg.
textTranslated: Cozy hotel close to Dubai Mall and with a view of Burj Khalifa. Good starting point for shopping. ||The rooms are large, spacious and in good condition. From the suite, the view from the balcony towards Burj Khalifa is absolutely fantastic. ||The staff were helpful and service-minded despite a few problems with rooms on different floors - this was resolved. ||The breakfast buffet offered a large inviting selection.

feedback_text: Hotellet ligger simpelthen så godt som man kan ønske sig. Let til Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa og skønne gåture i områderne omkring. Der er ca. 20 minutters gang på gode boulevarder til Metroen og hele Dubai ligger for dine fødder. Personalet og hotellet er præget af en høj grad af service og venlighed og der er gode store værelser med høj kvalitet. Lækker morgenmad og et hotel der emmer af hygge og ro.
textTranslated: The hotel is simply as well located as you could wish for. Easy access to Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa and lovely walks in the surrounding areas. It is about a 20 minute walk on good boulevards to the Metro and all of Dubai is at your feet. The staff and the hotel are characterised by a high degree of service and friendliness and there are good large rooms with high quality. Delicious breakfast and a hotel that exudes cosiness and tranquility.

feedback_text: 去过迪拜很多次了，我们也入住过很多酒店，但这家感觉是最好最独特的。大堂布置很细致，服务员服务很到位，房间里的设施都非常温馨。每晚入睡前，服务员会提供椰枣和巧克力，还有一张小卡片，十分温馨。最棒的是距离购物中心The Dubai Mall 非常近，购物很方便。这家酒店低调但不平庸，处处充满了对客人的关心。
textTranslated: I have been to Dubai many times and stayed in many hotels, but this one feels the best and most unique. The lobby is very detailed, the waiter service is very good, and the facilities in the room are very warm. Every night before going to bed, the waiter will provide dates and chocolates, as well as a small card, which is very warm. The best thing is that it is very close to the shopping mall The Dubai Mall, which is very convenient for shopping. This hotel is low-key but not mediocre, and is full of care for guests.

feedback_text: 今年2月，老公和我在马尔代夫和迪拜度过了超级难忘和甜蜜的蜜月。迪拜对我们而言是个奢华而又神秘的国度，当时也是参考了tripadvisor以及到到上的精彩点评，才使我们选择了QAMARDEEN，事实证明真是明智之举。|    我们到达QAMARDEEN已是深夜了，酒店的值班人员依旧非常热情的接待了我们，并且送来了特色阿拉伯蜜枣和蜜橘饮料，非常可口。酒店的装潢感觉既时尚又低调，色调也很舒服，大堂总是播放着淡淡的smooth jazz，我超喜欢的那种。|    我们的房间位置很不错，打开阳台就能看到夜色中的泳池，往右一看就是闻名遐迩的迪拜塔。我想这种景观，这个价位（每晚1200RMB左右），还是非常值得的了。房间布置温馨，而且打扫的非常干净，这令我很满意。要说不足的话，似乎床还是稍小了一点，另外淋浴间设计似乎有点问题，总是会有水淌出来，幸亏不是很多。但是这些不足丝毫没有影响我对这个酒店的喜爱，因为他们的服务非常到位，下面我会谈到。|    第二天早晨我们下楼享用了酒店的早餐，我觉得早餐非常丰富，甚至比我在马尔代夫banyan tree享受到的早餐更加诱人。早餐完毕，我们就去大堂前台询问去The Dubai Mall的路线，并且预约了下午的冲沙。前台的态度超级nice，很耐心很详细的为我们讲述了路线，并且推荐了附近具有阿拉伯特色的饭店，关于冲沙他们更是详尽的为我们介绍了时间和具体的游玩方式。后来只要我们有不明白的地方都会跑去问前台，前台的巴基斯坦帅哥每次见到我们都会微笑着打招呼。我想如果不是酒店前台如此热心我们在迪拜还真可能有点没方向了，毕竟是自由行嘛。|    迪拜是个迷人的地方，这次蜜月主要是马尔代夫的banyan tree，由于在迪拜转机，所以正好出境玩了三天。所幸的是QAMARDEEN着实给了我们不小惊喜。不但因为它紧邻迪拜塔和the dubai mall的卓越的地理位置，更因为酒店细心和温暖的服务。
textTranslated: In February this year, my husband and I spent a super unforgettable and sweet honeymoon in Maldives and Dubai. Dubai is a luxurious and mysterious country for us. At that time, we also referred to the wonderful reviews on tripadvisor and taodao, which made us choose QAMARDEEN. It turned out to be a wise move. | It was late at night when we arrived at QAMARDEEN. The staff on duty at the hotel still received us very warmly and sent us special Arabic dates and tangerine drinks, which were very delicious. The decoration of the hotel feels both fashionable and low-key, and the color is also very comfortable. There is always a faint smooth jazz playing in the lobby, which I like very much. | Our room is in a good location. When you open the balcony, you can see the swimming pool in the night. Looking to the right is the famous Dubai Tower. I think this kind of view and this price (about 1200RMB per night) are still worth it. The room is warmly decorated and cleaned very cleanly, which makes me very satisfied. If there is any shortcoming, it seems that the bed is still a little small. In addition, the design of the shower room seems to have some problems. There is always water flowing out, but fortunately not a lot. But these shortcomings did not affect my love for this hotel at all, because their service is very good, which I will talk about below. | The next morning we went downstairs to enjoy the hotel breakfast. I think the breakfast is very rich, even more tempting than the breakfast I enjoyed at Banyan Tree in Maldives. After breakfast, we went to the lobby front desk to ask about the route to The Dubai Mall and made an appointment for sandboarding in the afternoon. The attitude of the front desk was super nice. They patiently and in detail told us the route and recommended nearby Arabic-style restaurants. Regarding sandboarding, they introduced the time and specific ways of playing to us in detail. Later, whenever we had something we didn’t understand, we would run to ask the front desk. The handsome Pakistani guy at the front desk would smile and greet us every time he saw us. I think if the hotel front desk was not so enthusiastic, we might really be a little lost in Dubai, after all, it was a free trip. | Dubai is a charming place. This honeymoon is mainly Banyan Tree in Maldives. Because of the transfer in Dubai, it happened to be out of the country for three days. Fortunately, QAMARDEEN really gave us a lot of surprises. Not only because of its excellent geographical location close to the Burj Khalifa and the dubai mall, but also because of the hotel’s attentive and warm service.
